description: This endpoint returns the specification section revision.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Unique identifier for the specification section revision.

schema.description: A version of a Specification Section. This schema represent a selected version of a specification section and also all the versions of the specification section.

selected_revision.description: The selected revision of the specification section

id.description: The unique identifier of the selected revision

division.description: Represents a construction division, which is used to group specification sections. Each SpecificationSectionDivision can contain many SpecificationSections.

issued_date.description: The date when the SpecificationRevision was issued by the architect

received_date.description: The date when the SpecificationRevision was received by the project

revision.description: The revision number of the SpecificationSectionRevision

specification_area_name.description: Name of the associated specification area. `null` when the specification section does not belong to an area.

long_description.description: Human-readable section label in the format `<number> - <description>`.

size.description: Size in bytes of the associated prostore_file. `null` if the revision has no associated prostore_file.

content_type.description: MIME content type of the associated prostore_file. `null` if the revision has no associated prostore_file.

s3_key.description: S3 object key for the associated prostore_file. `null` if the revision has no associated prostore_file.

confirmed_by.description: The user who confirmed the specification section revision

all_revisions.description: All revisions of the specification section

403.description: User does not have right permissions
